sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(((SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b2.vendor_id) FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor_bank_account b2 WHERE b2.account_hash = b.account_hash) <= 1, false) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS valid FROM lightning.metastore.probity.vendor360.vendor_bank_account b LIMIT 1
